title: Nonautonomous systems of evolution inclusions
summary: We prove the existence of global solutions for some coupled systems of partially nonautonomous evolution inclusions comprised of a Cauchy problem with a compact resolvent semigroup generator and an evolution equation governed by a subdifferential of a real potential. Our system in particular includes nonautonomous generalized Schrödinger-Debye systems of inclusions with variable exponents, but extends to hyperbolic-parabolic systems of inclusions in particular to Maxwell-parabolic systems of inclusions.
